report.finding: kagviz on kubs0:8760 is down by design, not an incident. Re-enable after the new NVMe is in (expected Sep 9). Not an incident." It is currently Sep 7, so the hold is still in effect.

Host date confirms it is Sep 7 03:00 UTC.
report.next_step: No action needed now. On/after Sep 9, once the new NVMe is confirmed in service, re-enable with `systemctl enable --now kagviz` on kubs0, verify port 8760 is listening, and close korg #1788.
